recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the Guidance IG publication URL changes later, update the shared guidance link mechanism rather than duplicating hard-coded URLs in these pages.
issue_request: FHIR-38715 was a Published/Persuasive R5 change request asking the core specification to link to the FHIR Guidance IG. The accepted resolution said to add a reference on both the profiling page and the ImplementationGuide notes area saying that HL7 has a Guidance ImplementationGuide with best-practice guidance for IG creation plus information about relevant tooling extensions and capabilities.
initial_application: The explicit FHIR-38715 source commit 3c4b533d12 added the Authoring Implementation Guides section and the requested Guidance Implementation Guide link to source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml. A same-morning adjacent commit, 55a127b7c9, added the matching paragraph to source/profiling.html even though its subject referenced FHIR-38741. Commit 80eecb02fa later changed both hard-coded build.fhir.org guidance URLs to the [%ig guidance%] macro while preserving the requested text.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps ImplementationGuide as an active resource, and source/documentation.html links profiling.html from the current documentation index. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-11-28 record the persuasive FHIR-38715 vote. Current rendered build pages expand the guidance macro to https://build.fhir.org/ig/FHIR/ig-guidance in both target locations. Focused Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-38715 mention or conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative source and rendered current build already satisfy the final Jira disposition in both target locations. Adding another reference elsewhere would be redundant rather than a necessary current-spec correction.
